1. The shape, before and after

The #3933 shape: a gate whose "nothing found" result is byte-identical to "checked and clean". Every consumer reads the empty result as pass. The fix is the same everywhere: assert the input exists and is non-empty before judging it.

Before (35 gates)

flowchart LR
  A["input absent: empty dir, empty JSON file, failed fetch, wrong path"] --> B["loop never iterates, or a guard short-circuits"]
  B --> C["counter stays 0"]
  C --> D{"failures == 0 ?"}
  D -->|yes| E["PASSED: All 0 skills ... exit 0"]
  style E fill:#3a1d1d,stroke:#f85149,color:#fff
  style A fill:#1d2230,stroke:#58a6ff,color:#fff

After (this branch)

flowchart LR
  A["input absent"] --> B["loop never iterates"]
  B --> C["counter stays 0"]
  C --> F{"scanned == 0 ?"}
  F -->|yes| G["FAIL: zero X found, nothing was checked, exit 1"]
  F -->|no| D{"failures == 0 ?"}
  D -->|yes| E["PASSED with N above 0"]

  style E fill:#1d3a24,stroke:#3fb950,color:#fff

5. Follow-ups found by the audit, outside this PR

  • filed #3937 tests/plugins/validate-all.sh: orphan, passes on absent input, fails on the real tree. Delete, or fix the ork-* glob and zero-count returns and rename to test-validate-all.sh.
  • fails closed test-build-drift.sh section B: Apple diff -q - cannot read stdin from a pipe, so every agent is CHANGED on macOS (36 of 36 measured). Local-only red, CI green.
  • inert at HEAD test-marketplace-structure.sh Tests 4 and 5 capture the literal git-subdir from object sources; MISSING_PATHS and MISSING_MANIFESTS are structurally 0. Test 2 was already moved to jq.
  • wrong root test-cc-discovery-simulation.sh audits src/agents when plugin.json carries no agents key, while the plugin ships plugins/ork/agents.
  • claimed readme-link-audit.yml: key the clean branch on the output being present, not on == 0.
  • by design version-check.yml skips every conventional branch prefix (release-please owns versions); only the empty-diff hole was fixable.
DECIDE
  1. #3937: delete validate-all.sh (recommended) or repair and wire it.
  2. After this PR merges: open the #3306 lane next (recommended), or #1848 to close CC adoption first.
  3. Video Gallery milestone: re-scope with a new date, or close as deferred (recommended: close).
